Michael / Marissa — tagging in with security/compliance guidance for this request. Below is the checklist we should provide to Acme and internal owners. This follows our standard disclosure and redaction policy.

What to include in outbound package:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF, signed by auditor) — include cover letter, scope page, and opinion.
- Bridge letter (management assertion) if Acme requires coverage outside 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31.
- Evidence manifest (CSV): control id, sample name, owner, timestamp, storage path (we redact internal IP addresses).
- Control matrix / mapping to SIG/CAIQ if requested (summary doc).
- Auditor contact (PWC) and engagement ID for verification.

Redaction & sharing rules:
- Remove internal employee PII (use initials only), redact customer names from sample artifacts unless we have permission.
- Do not share raw server logs; provide summarized excerpts with timestamps.
- All artifacts uploaded to the secure bucket must be encrypted and objects set to expire after 30 days. Provide pre-signed URLs with 72-hour validity for each artifact.

Delivery options (security preference order):
1) Pre-signed S3 URLs (preferred) — provide a secure index file listing links.
2) Box shared folder with enforced access controls.
3) SharePoint secure link (least preferred due to cross-tenant permission friction).

Internal timeline we propose:
- Prepare SOC 2 PDF + scope & auditor details by 2026-11-03 EOD.
- Evidence manifest and redaction review by 2026-11-04 EOD.

Related items: HubSpot deal HS-43219 (Acme RFP), internal drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cdef-example

Attachments: evidence_manifest.csv, redaction_guidelines.md
